title: Phase 2: Mock tier tests + CI workflow
description:
Implement mock tier tests using stubserver LLM backend (Plan 22 §4.3, §5.1, §11):

- tests/e2e/test_deployment_modes.py — Mock tier tests DM-M1 through DM-M8 for configs C1 and C2
- tests/e2e/test_sandbox_config.py — Tools-in-sandbox tests (§5.1)
- .github/workflows/e2e-external.yml — CI workflow running mock tier on every PR
- Stubserver fixture integration (§12.2)

Tests use stubserver as LLM backend. Verify orchestrator wiring, RPC transport, session lifecycle, tool dispatch, health monitoring. Port scheme: orchestrator 18080, sandbox-host 18082/18083, stubserver 19090.

References: docs/plans/22-e2e-external-tests.md §4.3, §5.1, §11, §12.2
